name: Zoo Patrol
description_short: A half-day summer week at Connecticut's Beardsley Zoo in Bridgeport for ages 7-10 and 11-13, running 9 am to 12:30 pm. Each day children explore a different area of the zoo outdoors, hear staff talks on animal care, enrichment and veterinary care, and play zoo-themed games and art activities.
